thread:
Mia: Quick ask — we need a short battlecard + 2 launch-post headlines + a benchmark snippet for the webinar. Audience: SDRs + field. Focus: 'serving-first' economic hook vs cloud AI endpoints and LLM APIs.
Raj: Love it. Can we prioritize claims we can prove with existing internal dashboards? latency, tokens/sec, and 95th percentile tail.
Olivia: I'll draft 2 headlines. Proposed: "Ship LLM features without surprise bills" and "Predictable latency, predictable cost — Redwood Inference". Thoughts?
Sam: First one lands. Second is a bit long. Maybe compress to "Predictable latency. Predictable cost. Redwood." :thumbsup:
Mia: Good call. Raj — can you pull 2 benchmark slices: (1) 2K token stream median latency vs a popular managed endpoint; (2) cost per 1M tokens after batching & caching.
Raj: On it. I can run the precomputed query — need to confirm the comparator org (we used vendor-x last quarter). Tagging @ops-bot to confirm numbers are cleared for external use.
ops-bot: @Raj Benchmark request received. Please confirm comparator label (vendor-x-prod) and the date range.
Raj: comparator=vendor-x-prod, range=2026-02-01..2026-02-28. Also include quantization-enabled model variants.
Neil: For SDRs, we need soundbites: 1) "Slash per-token bills with runtime batching" 2) "Fallbacks keep app alive when capacity spikes" 3) "Pin model versions for predictable behavior". Short, <140 char.
Jordan: For inbound routing: add a 'benchmark interest' tag to the demo form that routes to AE bench-specialist. Also add 'dedicated/private' for enterprise routing.
Mia: Webinar slot is locked for 2026-04-08. We need a 2-slide benchmark story: slide 1 = methodology (what we compared), slide 2 = headline numbers + short caveats. Keep audience non-technical.
Olivia: Draft for slide text (short):
```
Methodology: 2k-token prompts, steady 200 qps sustained, identical prompt sets.
Headline: 40% lower median latency, 3x lower tail events, 22% lower $/1M tokens post-batching.
Caveat: results vary by model and region; see appendix for raw metrics.
```
Sam: That codeblock is great. Add "verified on Redwood infra, Feb 2026" at bottom.
Raj: I will attach raw query and dashboard links in the PR. ops-bot — can we get sign-off by EOD tomorrow for external release?
ops-bot: @Raj Requested. Compliance check queued. ETA 24 hours.
Mia: Action items: Olivia — finalize headlines + slide text by tomorrow noon. Raj — attach dashboards + comparator queries. Jordan — update demo routing fields. Neil — generate 3 SDR one-liners. Sam — prep short blog post intro. We'll sync 10am PT tomorrow.
All: :raised_hands:
